cases.prompt: Implement a production adapter plan for locally available champion-select state. Include a typed contract, loopback transport boundary, cache behavior, fixtures, and canary policy.

criteria.statement: Defines typed error outcomes including offline, unauthorized, parse, schema_drift, and policy_blocked rather than using an untyped catch-all.
Uses a loopback-only client with in-memory LCU authentication and does not permit that TLS behavior for remote requests.
Bounds retries to transient failures and excludes authorization, parse, schema drift, and policy failures from retries.
Plans sanitized fixture tests and an opt-in canary that reports schema drift without storing credentials or real match data.

cases.prompt: Implement a normalized third-party build-statistics adapter with an approved provider assessment. Include terms, attribution, population labels, cache dimensions, compatibility gates, fixtures, and fallback behavior.

criteria.statement: Requires documented terms, attribution, redistribution review, schema-drift handling, and a compatibility decision before use.
Preserves provider, patch, region, tier, queue, lane, and sample-window population in normalized provenance.
Includes provider and all response-changing population dimensions in the cache key with explicit TTL and stale policy.
Allows fallback only after an explicit compatibility matrix and keeps fallback attribution visible.

cases.prompt: Design fallback behavior when a versioned static-data provider is temporarily unavailable and an approved mirror contains the same version, locale, fields, terms, and attribution requirements.

criteria.statement: Verifies version, locale, normalized fields, terms, attribution, and freshness compatibility before using the mirror.
Records the mirror as the actual source in provenance and does not claim the primary source supplied the value.
Uses bounded transient retries and returns a typed failure if the approved fallback cannot satisfy the contract.
Validates equivalent sanitized fixtures before enabling the compatible fallback.
